areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Consistent fit via urban mobility, infrastructure and drainage with a large investment share; weak integration with housing and social policies keeps it sectoral.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: Green infrastructure, park expansion, spring protection and nursery with specific indicators; roughly 30% of resources and high environmental-quality impact.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Flood-point reduction indicator exists, but interventions are localized and corrective, with a small resource share and no climate governance or alert systems.

areas.name: Clean energy
areas.reason: Rooftop solar on public buildings is technically sound with local indicators, but a very small resource share makes it complementary rather than structuring.

areas.name: Women
areas.reason: Urban programme with no objectives, indicators or resources for women's rights; park video-monitoring only indirectly affects perceived safety.

areas.name: Public safety
areas.reason: No security objectives or indicators; only a small, accessory video-monitoring item in parks.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Park upgrades only indirectly enable physical activity; no sport objectives, indicators or resources; very small resource share.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Urban works only indirectly affect the business environment; not oriented to productive chains or competitiveness.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Only indirect intra-municipal effects; no targeting of vulnerable territories, distributive indicators or equity-based prioritization.
